nodes.name: CRM Delivery Webhook
nodes.notes: Production path is /crm-qr-delivery. Copy the production Webhook URL into the CRM's N8N_WEBHOOK_URL setting after activating this workflow. Authenticated with the shared 'CRM Delivery Shared Secret' Header Auth credential (X-N8N-Webhook-Secret) — this must hold the same value as the CRM's N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Validate Payload
nodes.notes: Confirms the CRM sent every field this workflow needs before attempting to send anything. Never sends a message on incomplete data.

nodes.name: Route By Channel
nodes.notes: Routes on the CRM-supplied 'channel' field: EMAIL, WHATSAPP, or anything else falls to the unsupported-channel failure branch (the 'extra' fallback output, produced automatically by rules-mode fallbackOutput). Output order is rules.values order then the fallback: index 0 = EMAIL, index 1 = WHATSAPP, index 2 = fallback/unsupported. Rebuilt for n8n's current rules-mode Switch schema — the previous 'expression'+'outputKey' combination is from the pre-rules Switch parameter shape and made the node try to push into an output array that does not exist, throwing "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')" on every execution.

nodes.name: Prepare QR Attachment
nodes.notes: Converts the CRM-supplied base64 QR PNG into a binary attachment for the email node. No patient data is decoded or altered — the QR remains the same opaque image the CRM generated.

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Uses a clinic-owned SMTP credential configured directly in n8n. No credentials are stored in this workflow file. Subject and body use only fields already present in the CRM payload.

parameters.subject: Your Smriti Raj Dentistry QR Code

nodes.name: Build FAILED Callback (Email Error)
nodes.notes: Only the provider's error message is forwarded, never raw provider response bodies, headers, or credentials.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Branch (Not Configured - Placeholder)
nodes.notes: WhatsApp is intentionally not wired to a real provider yet. See n8n/README.md section E. To enable: add either a Meta WhatsApp Cloud API node/credential or a Twilio WhatsApp node/credential here, then route its success/error outputs the same way the Email branch does. Do not add API keys, access tokens, test phone numbers, or template IDs to this workflow file — configure them as n8n credentials only.

nodes.name: Build FAILED Callback (WhatsApp Not Configured)
nodes.notes: permanent: true (non-retryable) — a missing WhatsApp provider credential cannot self-heal by retrying the same message later; it only changes once a clinic admin configures a real provider in n8n. Retrying it would just burn through the delivery's limited retry budget for no chance of success.

assignments.name: failure_reason
assignments.value: WhatsApp delivery is not yet configured for this clinic. Configure a Meta WhatsApp Cloud API or Twilio WhatsApp credential in n8n to enable this channel.

nodes.name: Build FAILED Callback (Invalid Payload)
nodes.notes: Missing-data failures are marked permanent — retrying the same incomplete payload will never succeed. If idempotency_key or callback_url itself is missing, the CRM cannot be notified at all; that case is only visible in this workflow's execution log.

nodes.name: Can Notify CRM?
nodes.notes: Guards against calling out to an empty callback_url (only possible if the CRM's own payload omitted it).

nodes.name: Notify CRM (Callback)
nodes.notes: Posts the result back to the CRM's existing /webhooks/n8n/delivery endpoint using the exact contract fields (idempotency_key, status, provider_message_id, failure_reason, permanent) and the shared X-N8N-Webhook-Secret header. Do not add a second auth mechanism here.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { idempotency_key: $json.idempotency_key, status: $json.status, provider_message_id: $json.provider_message_id || null, failure_reason: $json.failure_reason || null, permanent: $json.permanent || false } }}

nodes.name: Cannot Notify CRM (Missing callback_url)
nodes.notes: Terminal safety branch. The CRM always sends callback_url, so reaching this node indicates a payload contract mismatch worth investigating in n8n's execution log.
